LESSON: READING 12.2.1 INTENSIVE READING: COMPREHENSION STRATEGIES

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 12
Topic 12.2: Reading 12.2.1 Intensive Reading: Comprehension Strategies
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 12.2.1 Intensive Reading: Comprehension Strategies, part of Strand 12 in Grade 8 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: What do you remember most after reading a text? 2. How do we get information from a text?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. read the passage on modern fashion and underline sentences that create mental images,

2. read the passage on modern fashion in turns as they answer direct and inferential questions,

3. work with peers to infer the meaning of words and expressions using contextual clues,

4. present mental pictures from the text on charts and display them. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. read the passage on modern fashion and underline sentences that create mental images,
2. read the passage on modern fashion in turns as they answer direct and inferential questions,
3. work with peers to infer the meaning of words and expressions using contextual clues,
4. present mental pictures from the text on charts and display them. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading 12.2.1 Intensive Reading: Comprehension Strategies together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Critical thinking: It is enhanced as the learner identifies mental images and infers meanings of words.

• Collaboration: It is enhanced as the learner contributes to group decision making while working with peers to infer the

meaning of words and expressions using contextual clues.

Values:
Responsibility: It developed as the learner accomplishes assigned tasks while presenting mental pictures from the text on charts

and displaying them.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Personal hygiene: It is enhanced as the learner reads passages on fashion.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The information acquired through reading texts on modern fashion is relevant in Social Studies.
